name: Pia
self_text: I am a Japanese man in my late 20s. Outside of gaming, I enjoy knitting because it is relaxing. I play Tidewatch on PC. I play ranked matches. I am available on Saturday afternoons.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into casual matches. It would be a small bonus if you are into Tidewatch, and it's nice if you are available Saturday afternoon, but no big deal.
